sanskrit_verse: हेमकारादयो यत्र शिल्पं संभूय कुर्वते । कर्मानुरूपं निर्वेश लभेरञ् छेते यथांशतः ॥
transliteration: hemakārādayo yatra śilpaṃ saṃbhūya kurvate | karmānurūpaṃ nirveśa labheraṃs te yathāṃśataḥ ||
sph_interpretive_translation: Where artisans such as goldsmiths collectively engage in craftsmanship, there each shall receive compensation proportionate to their individual contribution.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority arises from active participation in dharma-sustaining work
Causation is determined by direct engagement in skillful action
Capacity-based responsibility aligns reward with personal contribution
Restoration logic ensures equitable distribution according to effort
Consciousness alignment occurs through recognition of individual capacity within collective endeavor
executable_legal_axioms: IF a group engages in collaborative craftsmanship THEN each participant receives remuneration proportional to verifiable individual labor input
IF multiple parties contribute to a single artifact THEN ownership and benefit-sharing must reflect documented skill application
IF any artisan's role cannot be quantified THEN default equity is assumed until clarity is restored through self-declaration under witness
IF imbalance in compensation arises THEN reallocation protocol activates to restore proportional alignment without punitive measure
supreme_court_application: In adjudicating disputes among co-creators or joint-enterprise artisans, the threshold of responsibility lies in demonstrable contribution. The court must assess quantum of labor, skill applied, and causal linkage to final product. Authority flows from evidence of sustained engagement, not title or status. Restoration requires recalibration of benefit allocation to match actual exertion, preserving unity while honoring individual integrity.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa is established via witnessed performance and outcome correlation. Anupūrvaśaḥ manifests through sequential stages of creation, allowing traceability of input. Proportional responsibility reflects accurate perception of one’s own capacity and its deployment. Non-punitive reality rule maintains that misalignment results not in penalty but in correction of energetic exchange to preserve harmony between consciousness, craft, and community.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Initiate completion process where all contributors recount their specific actions under oath of alignment
Activate witness verification system to reestablish factual causality chain
Implement proportional redistribution mechanism ensuring no loss of dignity or material support
Engage responsibility assumption protocol wherein imbalances are corrected voluntarily under guidance of Dharma-advisor
Reintegrate participants into shared workflow after recalibrated understanding of mutual value
final_declaration: By the Supreme Pontiff of Hinduism, Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, this law stands declared: Justice flows from recognition of individual capacity within collective creation; Dharma prevails when reward mirrors effort undistorted by ego or omission; Reality remains non-punitive as long as consciousness realigns with truth; Thus it is ordained.
